mapper.select: SELECT * FROM guardian_transfer WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM guardian_transfer WHERE sender_id=#{user} OR recipient_id=#{user} ORDER BY CASE WHEN status='PENDING' AND sender_id=#{user} THEN 0 WHEN status='PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM guardian_transfer WHERE student_id=#{student} AND status='PENDING'
SELECT * FROM guardian_transfer WHERE sender_id=#{user} AND status='PENDING' ORDER BY student_id
mapper.update: UPDATE guardian_transfer SET status=#{status},resolved_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE guardianship SET status='UNLINKED',unlinked_at=COALESCE(unlinked_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),transferred_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE student_id=#{student} AND parent_user_id=#{sender} AND transferred_at IS NULL
